/**
 * Phase R1.c · Feb-2026 — helper for downloading a server-generated
 * PDF export while preserving the authenticated session.
 *
 * The default ``api`` client parses every response as JSON, which
 * corrupts binary PDF bytes. We can't hand a signed URL to a
 * bare ``<a href>`` either because the JWT lives in
 * ``localStorage`` — a link would drop it. So we ``fetch`` with
 * the same auth headers, coerce the response into a ``Blob``,
 * generate an object URL, and trigger a same-tab download via
 * a synthetic anchor.
 *
 * Falls back cleanly:
 *   * server 401/403/404 → throws an ``Error`` with the parsed
 *     ``detail`` (matches the ``api.js`` shape so callers can
 *     surface it via ``toast.error``).
 *   * network error → throws ``"Network error — check your
 *     connection and try again."`` (same copy as ``api.request``).
 *
 * ``api_base`` and ``TOKEN_KEY`` are already exported by
 * ``@/api``. In tests, ``@/api`` is mocked so this helper stays
 * import-safe.
 */import{api_base,TOKEN_KEY}from"@/api";async function _authFetch(path){const url="".concat(api_base()).concat(path);let token=null;try{token=localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);}catch(_unused){/* localStorage unavailable */}const headers=token?{Authorization:"Bearer ".concat(token)}:{};let res;try{res=await fetch(url,{headers});}catch(_unused2){throw new Error("Network error — check your connection and try again.");}if(!res.ok){let msg="Request failed (".concat(res.status,")");try{const text=await res.text();const parsed=JSON.parse(text);msg=(parsed===null||parsed===void 0?void 0:parsed.detail)||msg;}catch(_unused3){/* body was not JSON */}const err=new Error(msg);err.status=res.status;throw err;}return res;}/**
 * Fetch ``/api${path}`` with the current auth token and trigger a
 * download of the response body as ``filename``.
 *
 * Idempotent-ish: if the browser environment doesn't support
 * ``URL.createObjectURL`` (JSDOM in tests), we resolve to the
 * blob so tests can assert content-type + size without needing
 * a full DOM download stub.
 */export async function downloadServerPdf(path,filename){const res=await _authFetch(path);const blob=await res.blob();if(typeof URL==="undefined"||typeof URL.createObjectURL!=="function"){return blob;}const href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);const a=document.createElement("a");a.href=href;a.download=filename||"report.pdf";a.rel="noopener";document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();// Release the object URL on the next tick so Safari doesn't
// cancel the download.
setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(href),1000);return blob;}export default downloadServerPdf;
